headline: Fuel: Government Does Not Extend Tax Relief, Waits for EU
summary: The Meloni government has neither extended the fuel excise tax relief nor introduced a new tax reduction system. It is considering a floating excise tax and is waiting for the October 15–16 EU summit.
why: Fuel excise taxes set a large part of pump prices, which feed into consumer inflation and transport costs. Changes in these taxes affect fuel demand and the outlook for energy companies.
